rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for physical rubbish and, more broadly, worthless stuff.

example.english: This bag of rubbish needs taking out.
example.jyutping: ni1 doi6 laap6 saap3 jiu3 ling1 heoi3 diu6

rows.note: Use this for rubbish that consists of nonsense or pointless talk.

example.english: I don't want to listen to your rubbish.
example.traditional: 你講嗰啲廢話我唔想聽。
example.jyutping: nei5 gong2 go2 di1 fai3 waa6 ngo5 m4 soeng2 teng1

rows.note: Use this for specifically low-quality or shoddy items rather than physical waste or nonsense.

example.english: These earphones are rubbish; they broke after two days.
example.traditional: 呢副耳機真係流嘢，買咗兩日就壞喇。
example.jyutping: ni1 fu3 ji5 gei1 zan1 hai6 lau4 je5 maai5 zo2 loeng5 jat6 zau6 waai6 laa3
